intro.zh: 今天这批项目透露出一个清晰信号：AI 正在从「聊天框」下沉到具体工作流和具体设备上。有人把助手塞进你已有的聊天软件，有人用纯 C 让大模型在旧电脑上跑起来，还有人把设计、科研、视频剪辑这些专业手艺拆成可安装的技能包。机会不在再造一个通用 agent，而在把某个垂直环节做深、做稳、做到别人愿意付费。
intro.en: Today's projects point to one shift: AI is moving out of the chat box and into concrete workflows and everyday hardware. Assistants now live inside the messaging apps you already use, large models run on old machines in pure C, and specialized crafts like design, research,

zh.summary: 一个跑在你自己电脑上的开源 AI 助手，直接接入 Discord、iMessage、Slack、Telegram 等二十多个聊天渠道，状态、记忆和凭证都留在本地硬件。模型和 agent 框架可插拔替换，同一套网关既能当个人助理也能做团队共享部署。
zh.insight: 切「数据不出内网」的团队场景：把网关部署在公司自己的机器上，卖的是部署、渠道对接和权限治理，而不是模型本身。和云端助手比，差异在合规和可控。

en.summary: An open-source assistant that runs on your own machine and plugs into twenty-plus chat channels like Slack, Telegram, and iMessage, keeping memory and credentials local.
en.insight: Target teams that cannot send data to a cloud vendor. Sell deployment, channel integration, and permission governance around the gateway rather than the model…

items.description: The AI that really does things. Any OS. Any Platform. The lobster way. 🦞

zh.summary: 一个非自回归的「系统一」决策引擎，对任意文本做类型化选择、打分和是/否判断，单次前向约 33 毫秒，覆盖 100 多种语言，并带按请求选检查点的路由器。提供 HTTP、MCP 和主流 agent 框架适配。
zh.insight: 适合替换 agent 流程里那些「用大模型做简单判断」的昂贵环节，比如意图分类、路由和审核。卖点是延迟和成本，切的是高并发、低复杂度的判定场景。

en.summary: A non-autoregressive decision engine that makes typed choices, scores, and yes/no calls over text in a single forward pass of about 33 ms across 100+ languages,
en.insight: Replace the expensive habit of calling a large model for simple judgments like intent routing and moderation.

items.description: Non-autoregressive System 1 decision engine. Typed choice, score and yes/no decisions over any text in a single forward pass, in 100+ languages, with a router that picks the right checkpoint per request.
items.category: AI 基础设施 / 模型

zh.summary: 纯 C 编写、零依赖的推理引擎，利用 MoE 模型每 token 只激活少量专家的特性，把专家留在磁盘、按需流式读取，从而在普通机器上跑数百亿参数的开源模型，不需要 GPU。
zh.insight: 这是基础设施层的信号：本地推理的门槛正被拉到消费级硬件。可以围绕它做「离线可用的私有模型盒子」，切对网络和隐私敏感的行业客户。

en.summary: A pure-C, zero-dependency inference engine that exploits MoE sparsity: only active experts sit in RAM while the rest stream from disk,
en.insight: A signal at the infrastructure layer: local inference is dropping to consumer hardware. Build an offline private-model appliance for industries that cannot…

items.description: Run frontier MoE models on hardware you already own — pure C, zero deps, experts streamed from disk. Tiny engine, immense model. 🐦
items.category: AI 基础设施 / 模型

zh.summary: 一个 macOS 菜单栏工具集，把按应用调音量、系统监控、窗口吸附、剪贴板历史、卸载器等通常要逐个付费购买的小工具收进一个图标，无账号、无遥测、无订阅，可按需安装单项功能。
zh.insight: 验证了「订阅疲劳」下的付费意愿：用户愿意为一次买断的实用工具付费。可以照此思路做 Windows 或跨平台的同类合集，靠口碑和本地化取胜。

en.summary: A macOS menu bar toolkit bundling per-app volume, system monitoring, window snapping, clipboard history, an uninstaller, and more behind one icon, with no account, telemetry,
en.insight: Proof that subscription fatigue creates willingness to pay once for utility. Replicate the bundle on Windows or cross-platform,

items.description: Free and open-source macOS menu bar toolkit.

zh.summary: 自托管的 WhatsApp API 网关，基于可插拔架构，数据库、媒体存储和缓存层都通过配置切换，面向需要完全掌控消息基础设施、不想被厂商锁定或按量收费的开发者。
zh.insight: 适合做中小商家的客服和通知自动化：以网关为底座，卖的是模板、合规话术和托管运维，而不是再包一层 API 转售。

en.summary: A self-hosted WhatsApp API gateway with a pluggable architecture: database, media storage, and cache are switched by config.
en.insight: Build customer-service and notification automation for small merchants on top of it. Sell templates, compliant messaging flows, and managed operations,

items.description: Free, Open Source, Self-Hosted WhatsApp API Gateway

zh.summary: 给 AI 编程工具补上设计能力的技能包，含 24 条命令、浏览器内实时迭代和 61 条确定性检测规则，专门治理 AI 生成前端千篇一律的模板感。装进现有编码工具即可用。
zh.insight: 面向接外包或做内部工具的小团队：把「AI 出稿后统一走一遍设计检查」做成流程，卖的是审美标准和检测规则，不是又一个生成器。

en.summary: A design skill for AI coding tools with 24 commands, live browser iteration, and 61 deterministic rules aimed at the sameness of AI-generated frontends.
en.insight: For small studios shipping client or internal tools: package a mandatory design-check pass after AI generation.

items.description: The design language that makes your AI harness better at design.

zh.summary: Google Play 服务的自由实现，让依赖 Play Services 的应用能运行在没有官方服务的系统上，覆盖登录、推送、定位等能力，是去谷歌化安卓设备的关键基础组件。
zh.insight: 这是趋势信号而非创业点：隐私导向的安卓生态仍有基础设施缺口。围绕它做设备预装、企业定制 ROM 或兼容性测试服务，比直接改核心更现实。

en.summary: A free implementation of Google Play Services that lets apps depending on it run on systems without the official stack, covering sign-in, push, and location.
en.insight: A trend signal rather than a startup idea: the privacy-first Android ecosystem still has infrastructure gaps.

zh.summary: 用纯 Rust 从零写的开源非线性视频剪辑器，覆盖剪辑、调色和声音，原生支持三大桌面系统，也能通过 WebAssembly 跑在浏览器里。同一团队还在做矢量绘图和 CAD 工具。
zh.insight: 浏览器内可用的专业剪辑器，意味着可以嵌进在线协作或教育场景。切「不想装大型软件、但要真剪辑」的用户，卖托管版和团队素材管理。

en.summary: An open-source non-linear video editor written from scratch in pure Rust, covering editing, color, and sound, native on macOS, Windows,
en.insight: A browser-capable pro editor can be embedded in online collaboration or education. Target users who will not install heavyweight software but need real…

items.description: FilmCraft: An open-source, nonlinear video editor written by scratch in pure Rust

zh.summary: 一份中文「高性价比人生指南」，765 条建议覆盖健康、理财、法律、社保、婚育和创业合规，每条标注成本、收益、证据等级和原始出处，并提供让 AI 按书回答的 skill。
zh.insight: 这是知识库加 skill 的样板：把高信任度的结构化内容做成可被 AI 检索引用的条目。可复制到税务、劳动法、医保等同样需要「有出处」的领域。

en.summary: A Chinese-language practical life guide with 765 recommendations on health, money, law, social insurance, family, and starting a business.
en.insight: A template for trusted knowledge plus a skill: structured, sourced content that AI can cite. Replicate it in domains like tax, labor law,

items.description: 高性价比人生指南: 长寿防病、急救、省钱理财、法律红线、失业与工伤、医保社保、恋爱婚育、怀孕育儿、创业与做平台合规、出国与技能。每条写明成本、收益、证据等级和原始出处，只引期刊论文与官方文件。

zh.summary: 面向科研人员的技能合集，把论文润色和科研绘图等 Nature 风格的工作流封装成可安装的 skill，支持 Claude Code、Codex 等工具，并提供网页版入口。
zh.insight: 科研写作是高频、高付费意愿的垂直场景。可以只切其中一环，比如图表规范检查或投稿格式转换，做成独立工具，比大而全的技能库更容易建立信任。

en.summary: A skill collection for researchers that packages Nature-style paper polishing and scientific figure work into installable skills for Claude Code, Codex, and similar tools,
en.insight: Academic writing is frequent and pays well. Narrow to one step, such as figure compliance checks or journal-format conversion,

items.description: 符合nature论文学术表达和科研绘图的Skill
